hero.headline: Build Tomorrow
hero.lead: A campaign for the School of Creative Technology. Equip studios. Fund Design Tomorrow. Put tools in student hands.

items.title: Technology Fund
items.body: Give through SCAD Giving. The STEC Technology Fund buys, repairs, and refreshes the tools students use.

items.title: Design Tomorrow
items.body: Sponsor at Title, Presenting, Track, or Partner. Sponsorships are processed by SCAD Giving.

items.title: Hardware
items.body: Fund or ship items from the wishlist. Use the two forms on Give to pledge in-kind or inquire.
